newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in noon trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in noon trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Thursday amid bearish market sentiment after falls in Malaysian palm oil exports, traders said.
They said palm olein was generally stable at 1,385 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, while crude palm oil was sold at 1,375 rupiah.

"Demand is slow today and trading has been very quiet. The expectation that prices will increase because of the Malaysian export figures has not materialised," said one trader in Medan, North Sumatra.
"We hope that prices will be stable tomorrow, even though the chance for price levels to fall is open because of the bearish trend," he added.
Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd on Thursday said it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for June 1-25 at 510,578 tonnes against 547,382 tonnes for May 1-25.
